default.$description: Neon glow at rest: Neon tube around a pink element (ADR-0051, BR-10). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

rest.$description: Rest neon glow around pink elements: blur 12px, spread 1px, 60% opacity (ADR-0051, Neon tube). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

hover.$description: Hover neon glow around pink elements: blur 20px, spread 2px, 85% opacity (ADR-0051, Neon tube). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

rest.$description: Rest neon glow around yellow elements: blur 12px, spread 1px, 60% opacity (ADR-0051, Neon tube). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

hover.$description: Hover neon glow around yellow elements: blur 20px, spread 2px, 85% opacity (ADR-0051, Neon tube). Edges only, never text (ADR-0052).

scrim.$description: How much of the page the overlay backdrop covers, from 0 to 1: black at 85% (ADR-0054).

overlay.$description: Overlay shadow: none. An overlay is lifted off the page by its outline and the dimming layer, and there is no shadow anywhere in the system (ADR-0054). Untyped, because `none` is not a DTCG shadow (ADR-0008).
